boards.title: Your First Weekend at Macalester College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence that starts on campus, makes room for student-life discovery, and ends with familiar places to return to during the term.

cards.title: Begin with the chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus orientation stop
cards.notes: Walk through the chapel during its posted open hours, locate the lower-level resources, and save it as a quiet landmark for future campus meetups.
cards.short_summary: An opening stop that pairs campus orientation with a recognizable gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester states that Weyerhaeuser Memorial Chapel hosts worship, lectures, art, music events, and other community functions, and publishes its open hours.
cards.source_title: Our Spaces | Center for Religious and Spiritual Life
cards.access_notes: The college lists chapel hours as Monday–Thursday 8:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m. and Friday 8:30 a.m.–8 p.m.; confirm any event-specific access.

cards.title: Get your bearings on the Great Lawn
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Use this open landmark to orient yourself between nearby buildings, then take a short daylight loop to identify routes you will use during the week.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor pause for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester identifies the Great Lawn on its campus map and describes it as a campus gathering space in its campus coverage.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access depends on weather and campus conditions; stay on public campus paths and follow posted event guidance.

cards.title: Make your first dinner simple
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Ruth Stricker Dayton Campus Center
cards.notes: Check the current dining page before you go, then use dinner to compare meal-plan logistics and arrange a low-pressure plan with new neighbors.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dinner stop with published meal-plan and service details.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester's 2026–27 dining information lists Café Mac in the Campus Center, accepted payment methods, and meal service periods.
cards.access_notes: Café Mac accepts meal swipes, Flex points, Mac Money, and credit cards; verify holiday and break hours on the dining site.

cards.title: Save a few groups to explore
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · student-life planning stop
cards.notes: Browse the active organizations directory, save a handful that genuinely interest you, and check each listing later for meeting details or upcoming events.
cards.short_summary: A practical way to turn broad interests into specific campus connections.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester directs students to Highland Hub to browse active student organizations, meeting times, and organization events.
cards.access_notes: Organization participation and meeting schedules vary; use Highland Hub or the organization directly for current information.

cards.title: Choose one current campus program
cards.subtitle: Friday night · flexible campus event slot
cards.notes: Filter the calendar for an event you can attend this weekend, then confirm its location, start time, admission details, and any registration instructions.
cards.short_summary: A flexible evening choice grounded in the live campus calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester's official events calendar includes filters for campus events, arts, athletics, films, lectures, and student-organization events.
cards.source_title: Event Search | Macalester College Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Admission, audience eligibility, and scheduling vary by listing; check the individual event page before attending.

cards.title: Take an active Saturday break
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus athletics facility
cards.notes: Check the space schedule, then choose an available activity such as swimming, fitness, or open recreation rather than arriving with a fixed plan.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with several possible activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester identifies the Leonard Center as its athletics facility and states that students can swim, run, lift weights, and play ping pong there.
cards.source_title: Classes and Programs | Wellness and Health at Macalester
cards.access_notes: Space schedules and reservations can change; the athletics department directs users to the EMS schedule for current availability.

cards.title: Look in on the current gallery show
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Janet Wallace Fine Arts Commons
cards.notes: Check what is currently installed, take time with one or two works, and look for related public talks or presentations before you leave campus.
cards.short_summary: A compact art stop inside Macalester's Fine Arts Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester states that the Law Warschaw Gallery is in the Janet Wallace Fine Arts Commons and hosts five to six exhibitions annually.
cards.source_title: Majors and Minors | Art and Art History
cards.access_notes: Exhibition dates and public access can vary; verify the current exhibition and building access before visiting.

cards.title: Check for a music performance
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Music Building
cards.notes: Look at the music and events calendars for a performance, then confirm whether the particular program is open to students and whether a ticket is required.
cards.short_summary: A performance-oriented stop at Macalester's accessible recital hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester describes Mairs Concert Hall as a 317-seat, fully accessible recital hall used for Music Department concerts, student recitals, and guest performances.
cards.access_notes: This is a performance venue, not general drop-in space; confirm the current program's time, audience rules, and ticketing.

cards.title: Spend Sunday outside at Como
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Saint Paul
cards.notes: Choose a daylight route on the paved trails, bring water, and use the city page to plan around the park's many facilities without trying to fit them all in.
cards.short_summary: A nearby city-park outing built around a short outdoor reset.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Saint Paul lists Como Regional Park's 2.3 miles of paved trails and its broad set of park facilities.
cards.source_title: Como Regional Park | City of Saint Paul
cards.access_notes: The City lists park hours from sunrise to 11 p.m.; use daylight for the walk and check separate attraction pages for facility-specific access.

cards.title: End with a library reset
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · 110 South Macalester Street
cards.notes: Find a study floor, browse the research guides, and identify the service desk so the building feels familiar before your first week becomes busy.
cards.short_summary: A quiet final stop that establishes a useful academic routine.
cards.evidence_claim: DeWitt Wallace Library provides research guides and study spaces, and publishes regular Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The library lists regular Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m.; breaks and holidays can change access, so verify before a late visit.

warnings: Event availability, venue access, and campus schedules can change; verify the direct source before attending.
